title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album Is Up for Preorder, Featuring 34 Tracks on Limited-Edition Vinyl, Standard Vinyl, or CD
summary: Preorders are live for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, which features 34 tracks and is available in limited-edition vinyl, standard vinyl, and CD.

By Chris Reed Updated : Sep 17, 2026 6:27pm UTC 17 comments Add IGN on Google Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album is now available to preorder , and six tracks have been released on the major streaming services. According to the official description, the album contains “34 original tracks that capture the electric energy of Grand Theft Auto VI’s world of Vice City and Leonida.” It’s set to release November 20, the day after the game itself comes out. It’s available in a number of editions and formats, with prices ranging from $19.98 to $124.98. Read on for the details. Featured in this article Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Amazon Exclusive Edition 0 $49.98 at Amazon Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Best Buy Exclusive Edition 0 $49.98 at Best Buy Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Limited-Edition Vinyl 1 $124.98 at Rockstar Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Vinyl 0 $49.98 at Rockstar Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - CD 0 $19.98 at Amazon $19.98 at Rockstar Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Blood Records Variant 0 $55.00 at Blood Records Out November 19 Grand Theft Auto 6 - PS5 Physical (Code in Box) 0 $79.99 at Amazon Out November 19 Grand Theft Auto 6 - Xbox Physical (Code in Box) 0 $79.99 at Amazon Every edition of the album includes the same tracks, which Rockstar describes as a “genre-defying roster of the most exciting artists in the world.” These include songs by Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, Keith Richards, and more, some of which Rockstar teased on social media. The differences in the editions all come down to format, vinyl designs, and bonus items. Details below. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Amazon Exclusive Edition Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Amazon Exclusive Edition 0 $49.98 at Amazon The Amazon-exclusive edition of the vinyl includes the songs on pink vinyl with purple splatter. The 2LP gatefold jacket includes an Amazon-exclusive 12x24 poster. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Best Buy Exclusive Edition Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Best Buy Exclusive Edition 0 $49.98 at Best Buy The Best Buy-exclusive edition of the album includes all 34 tracks on two clear pink with purple splatter vinyl records. The 2LP, gatefold jacket also includes a Best Buy-exclusive 12x24 poster. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Limited-Edition Vinyl Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Limited-Edition Vinyl 1 $124.98 at Rockstar The most luxurious (and priciest) option is the limited-edition vinyl. It includes two transparent magenta discs “filled with blue liquid,” which sounds pretty wild. It also has “exclusive new artwork and packaging designs that echo the iconic style of Grand Theft Auto VI.” Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Vinyl Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Vinyl 0 $49.98 at Rockstar The standard vinyl edition comes with all 34 tracks across two transparent magenta discs with blue splatter. It also has some splashy Florida — er, Leonida-inspired art on the sleeves. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - CD Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - CD 0 $19.98 at Amazon $19.98 at Rockstar The most modestly priced option is the CD version. It includes all 34 songs across two audio CDs, plus a booklet in a jewel case. Pretty standard stuff. It's available at Amazon and Rockstar. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Blood Records Variant Out November 20 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Blood Records Variant 0 $55.00 at Blood Records Blood Records also has an exclusive variant design on the vinyl records. Stream Select Tracks Now Listen on Amazon Music Listen on Apple Music Listen on Spotify You can stream the tracks below now on all the major music streaming services. Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album Track Listing (So Far) Yung Lean - That's It (feat. Future & Metro Boomin) Travis Scott - RHYNO (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo) CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.., & Etienne de Crécy - Sexy Magic Morgan Wallen - Last Thing You Need Rauw Alejandro - Macacoa 2000 Keith Richards - Bright Lights, Big City Above are all of the tracks Rockstar has announced (and released) so far. Twenty-eight tracks have yet to be announced. The actual game Grand Theft Auto VI is set to release November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preorders are live now, and if you do preorder it, you'll be able to preload it on your console starting November 12, a week ahead of launch.
